design.summary: 用户确认保留附件内嵌并采用矢量生成器。采用 pdfmake 渲染 HTML 文字、表格和 SVG，pdf-lib 合并约 192 Ki 字符片段；Noto Sans SC 随包提供。
evidence: Source inspection: internal/server/web/markdown-export.js lines 5, 142-147, 313-325 and attachment catalog code.
Architecture docs confirm current PDF is raster and previous browser print flow was replaced.

Official pdfmake docs: https://pdfmake.github.io/docs/0.3/ (vector/document generation and font embedding), https://pdfmake.github.io/docs/0.3/document-definition-object/attachments/ (embedded files and file annotations).
Official browser print API documentation says window.print opens the print dialog and returns no PDF bytes: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/print.
User selected: “保留附件内嵌，改用矢量生成器”.

implementation.summary: PDF 导出已切换至 pdfmake 矢量文本/表格/SVG，保留分片合并、中文字体、图像独立嵌入及 PDF 附件注释。PNG 单图仍由 html2canvas 渲染。
evidence: internal/server/web/markdown-export.js no longer calls html2canvas or jsPDF for PDF output.
Vendored pdfmake 0.3.13, html-to-pdfmake 2.5.29, pdf-lib 1.17.1 and Noto Sans SC variable font with licenses/checksums.
The code renders each bounded Markdown fragment separately and prepends merged pages into the last PDF, which carries embedded file attachment annotations.
